Make a dossier in one call

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_dossier.Rd

Run from a package's folder, run_dossier() compares that folder with the package's CRAN release: it installs both, runs the release's vignettes and help-page examples under each, compares everything they produce, writes the HTML report and the JSON, opens the report (in an interactive session) and returns the comparison, which prints a summary.

Usage

run_dossier(
  d = NULL,
  ...,
  html = file.path(d$work, "page"),
  json = file.path(d$work, "dossier.json"),
  open = interactive(),
  force = FALSE,
  ask = interactive(),
  timeout = Inf,
  step_timeout = 300,
  workers = 1L,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

d

A dossier(), or NULL for the package in the working directory (see "From a package folder").

...

Arguments of compare_runs(): tol, min_time, min_ratio, min_timings, plot_tol, api, accept and keep_metadata. The arguments after ... must be named in full.

html

Folder for the HTML report (write_dossier_html()), or NULL for none.

json

File for the JSON (write_dossier_json()), or NULL for none.

open

Open the report in the browser; by default only in an interactive session.

force

Reinstall both versions and repeat every run.

ask

Ask before every download: package sources, package indexes (once per repository and session) and dependencies.

timeout, step_timeout

Seconds one run may take, and one execution of a step (300 by default); see run_scenarios().

workers

Runs at once; see run_scenarios().

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

The comparison, an object of class pkgdossier_comparison; its $dossier is the dossier it was made from.

Details

It calls prepare_versions(), run_scenarios() and compare_runs() in turn. Each stage caches its work in the dossier's work folder, so a second call after changing the package rebuilds and reruns only the candidate, and a call with other comparison settings only compares again.

From a package folder

With no dossier, run_dossier() is run_dossier(dossier("<Package>")), where <Package> is the Package field of the working directory's DESCRIPTION: the folder against its CRAN release, with the release's vignettes and examples, and every other setting at dossier()'s default. Only the package's name is read from the folder. print(cmp$dossier) shows every setting.

Changing a setting

Each setting has one home, and a setting given in the wrong place is an error that writes out the call to use instead.

  • What is compared and how the runs are made go to dossier(): run_dossier(dossier("mypkg", base = cran_version("1.2.0"), reps = 0)).

  • How the runs go stays here: run_dossier(step_timeout = 900, workers = 2).

  • The comparison's tolerances go to compare_runs() through ...: run_dossier(tol = 1e-3).

Before upgrading a package you use, see what would change for you: run_dossier(dossier("ggplot2", base = installed_version(), candidate = cran_release())).

A quick look, without timings to label: run_dossier(dossier("mypkg", reps = 0), workers = 2). To keep the work between R sessions, give the dossier a work folder: dossier("mypkg", work = "~/dossiers/mypkg").

When it stops

Before anything is downloaded it stops when the working directory is not a package (naming the package around or below it, if any), and when a folder source does not hold the package or lacks a dependency. A package with no CRAN release, or an index that cannot be read, stops with the base to write instead. The errors have classes pkgdossier_error_not_package, pkgdossier_error_not_on_repo, pkgdossier_error_offline, pkgdossier_error_no_scenarios, pkgdossier_error_not_installed and pkgdossier_error_nothing_to_compare (the installed version is already the current release). A step that hangs is stopped after step_timeout and recorded; one that crashes R is recorded too; the dossier goes on without them.

Examples

# \donttest{
cmp <- run_dossier(example_dossier(), html = file.path(tempdir(), "dossier-page"),
                   open = FALSE)
